claims: The Artemis II moon mission launch is scheduled for April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II launch targets 6:35 p.m. EDT (22:35 UTC).
The Artemis II launch is from Kennedy Space Center, FL.
The Artemis II mission is a ~10-day journey around the Moon.
NASA's YouTube channel will stream live video from the Orion spacecraft throughout the Artemis II mission.
Live video of the Artemis II splashdown off the coast of San Diego is expected on NASA channels.
Tickets to the Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex are sold out.
NASA+ is a free streaming platform.
Official coverage of the Artemis II moon mission launch includes YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, and the NASA app.
